transcript.text: Hello, I'm here to help you get ready for your appointment. Could you tell me what has been bothering you?
It's my right knee — it's been aching on and off for about 3 years, but it's got noticeably worse over the last couple of months. It's getting in the way of what I normally do.
Do you have any allergies or bad reactions to medicines?
Yes — penicillin gives me a rash.
On a scale from 0 to 10, where 0 is no trouble at all and 10 is the worst it could be, how would you rate your knee these days?
On a bad day it's about a 7 out of 10. It's bad enough that I can't walk the dog round the park anymore.
What medicines are you taking these days?
I take metformin, 1 gram twice a day. Aspirin 75 mg once a day. Atorvastatin 40 mg at night. And ramipril 5 mg once a day.
Have you ever had an operation on your knee?
No, I've never had anything done to the knee.
Other than the aching, have you noticed anything else about your right knee?
The knee sometimes swells up a bit by the evening. There's no redness, no fever, and it doesn't lock up on me.
Is there anything that seems to make the aching in your right knee better or worse?
It's worse going down stairs, and after I've been walking for more than about 10 minutes. Rest helps, and so does paracetamol.
What worries you most about your right knee?
I'd like something stronger for the pain, to be honest. And I want to know whether I might end up needing a knee replacement.
Is there anything else about your health in the past that you'd like to add?
Yes — I've had type 2 diabetes for about 10 years, and I had a stent put in a heart artery 6 years ago.
Is there anything else you'd like to add about the medicines you take?
No, that's the lot — those are the four I take every day.
Is there anything else you've noticed about your right knee that you'd like to add?

The pain is on the inner side of the right knee and it doesn't spread down my leg. It's a deep, grinding sort of ache, and the knee feels stiff for about 20 minutes in the morning. I've also started going down the stairs one step at a time, holding the rail.
Is there anything else about your past health you'd like to add?
No, that's all I can think of — the diabetes and the heart stent are the main things.
Thank you, that is very helpful. I have put together a short summary of what you told me. Please read it and tell me if anything should be corrected before it goes to your doctor.
